items.name: Coupon Enhancement - prevent coupon overuse by limiting seat count.
items.description:
Marketing frequently launches acquisition campaigns targeting small businesses with offers such as 100% off for 3 months or similar introductory promotions. While these campaigns are intended for customers purchasing only a few seats, coupons can currently be redeemed against significantly larger purchases because there is no maximum seat restriction.
For example, a promotion intended for customers purchasing up to 3 seats can also be applied to a 20-seat purchase, resulting in substantial unintended discounts and ARR leakage.
This limitation prevents Marketing from confidently running targeted promotions and increases the risk of coupon abuse.

items.name: Partner with Performance Marketing & Web to carry forward messaging on paid media sign up throughout trial sign up experience
items.description:
Today we exclude paid media from all experimentation - yet changes to budget and campaigns directly influences the sign up rate and sign up performance. 

Goal of this project is to partner more closely with the performance marketing team to ensure their campaigns are supported through the end to end experience. Rather than excluding them, we should be including them in their separate tests and improvements

items.name: Pilot: Company domain requirement for 10% of audience
items.description:
Today, only company domain trial sign ups MQL yet we allow users to sign up with a personal domain. Personal domain sign ups are required to go through the entire sign up experience (personal domains aren't enriched with Clearbit), and purchase at a lower rate - yet make up 70% of total trial sign ups. 

Goal of this test is to require a company email domain in order to sign up for a trial, to a small subset of users, to understand the impact on sign ups, sign up rate, MQLs, win rate, etc. when we required a company domain.

items.name: Reduce duplicate trials for startups
items.description:
Users today can sign up for a CS/ES trial, and then sign up the startup application form to redeem the offer. This leads to duplicate trials - users signing up for both trial experiences. 

Goal of this improvement is to reduce the number of duplicate trial sign ups and startup sign ups and reduce customer confusion
